text:
julia: Quickstart refresh for the 'hello-serve' onboarding flow. Aim: fix auth snippets, tighten Dockerfile, and make first deployment work on Redwood Private. I'll split into 3 PRs: (1) examples/snippets, (2) deploy/Docker + helm, (3) auth + env var docs. Comments and volunteers?

 tom: I can own PR (1) — will port TS/py snippets to SDK v4 and add minimal MSW unit test.

 maya: I'll take (3). FYI the current snippet uses `RW_API_KEY` in examples; we should switch to `process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` and show `redwood config set` pattern. Also update Node and Python quickstart to use streaming example.

 julia: perfect. Tom — can you also add a small note about token scopes? we require `inference:invoke` for hosted.

 tom: yup. also adding a snippet for environment-local with `dotenv` and a one-liner for CI secrets: `echo $REDWOOD_TOKEN | redwood auth import --ci`

 docs-bot: Reminder: PR size limit 400 lines for docs sprint, auto-assign reviewers: @julia @maya

 maya: small UX nit: Quickstart landing page links to old 'hello-dock' repo. I'll update to the new mono-repo path. Anyone want to double-check the container healthcheck command? current CMD is `python app.py` but our entrypoint should be `gunicorn -w 1 app:app` for prod.

 ci-bot: CI builds passing on branch `docs/hello-refresh` — linting errors in py example (long lines) flagged.

 julia: thanks — Tom can you push fix for long lines, and add fenced code blocks with explicit language tags for syntax highlighting.

 tom: will do today. Plan to open PRs by EOD tomorrow-ish. tagging checklist:
 - snippets PR: update TS/py examples, inline auth, tests
 - docker PR: Dockerfile + helm values + healthcheck
 - auth PR: env var guide + token scope table + migration note from 'api_key' to 'redwood token'

 maya: I can review snippets PR quickly once opened. Also suggest adding a short migration guide paragraph: 'If you used SDK v2/v3, swap client init and check for streaming changes'.

 julia: Excellent. I'll write the release note blurb and update quickstart changelog. Ping me in thread when PRs are up. :partyparrot: 

 tom: ping — opened draft PR #923 on docs repo: `docs: quickstart hello-serve snippets (wip)` — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/923

 maya: opened auth PR draft #924.

 julia: LGTM on both drafts, setting reviewers. I'll squash/finalize tomorrow after tests. Thanks team!
